issue_request: FHIR-7043 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked for a constraint or note about using ValueSet lockedDate together with references to terminology versions newer than the locked date. The accepted resolution was to add a note that if versioned references are used with a locked date, those versions need to have been available on that date.
initial_application: SVN revision 5701, represented in git as b2187ba63870b9a2e85827b764d315b2e9bc2a2b, applied the issue with subject '#7043 - note about LockedDate' and added the exact availability note to the historical ValueSet spreadsheet. Later source migrations carried the wording into source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, so the current StructureDefinition source is in build scope. Related lockedDate issues FHIR-5982, FHIR-10490, and FHIR-18702 clarified context-dependence and definition wording but did not reverse the FHIR-7043 availability note. No direct Zulip or Confluence hits for FHIR-7043 were found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current lockedDate comment already states that if a value set specifies a version for include and exclude statements and also specifies a locked date, the specified versions need to be available that date or the value set will not be usable.
